Shri Rajneesh Kant Rajak - Advocate for the applicant
 Shri Pankaj Raj Ahirwar-P.L. for the respondent/State
 Ms. Aastha Nema - Advocate for the objector.

Order 
This is first bail application filed on behalf of applicant under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.

2. The applicant is in jail since 06.03.2025 in connection with Crime No. 190/2025 registered at P.S.
Madhavnagar, District- Katni, for the offence punishable under Sections 376(2) of IPC and Section 3 R/w 4, 5(L) R/w 6 of POCSO Act.
3. Prosecution story, in brief is that applicant repeatedly committed aggravated penetrative sexual assault on minor prosecutrix.
On account of which prosecutrix became pregnant and later on, on account of death of her child, prosecutrix expired.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is in jail since 06.03.2025.
After investigation, charge sheet has been filed.

It is urged NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:63137 2 MCRC-54765-2025 that material witnesses, including mother and father of deceased have been examined and they have turned hostile and did not support the prosecution story.
Suicide note has not been recovered.
There is no dying declaration on record.
The trial of the case will take considerable time.

Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant be released on bail Rajjan Chakraverty @ Ajju vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 4 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/76661560/
1 pending the trial.

sentences.text: 5. Learned counsel for the respondent/State, on the other hand, has opposed the application.
6. Learned counsel for the objector submits that she has no objection if applicant be released on bail.
7. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, first bail application under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

8. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.15,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
9.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.

1 0 . Soft copy of this bail order be sent immediately/forthwith to NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:63137 3 MCRC-54765-2025 applicant through concerned jail Superintendent.
11. M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed off.
12. Certified copy as per rules.
